Privileged operator migration intentionally handles wrapped vault/private/org keys, server verifiers, API keys and TOTP/recovery material. This is local secret custody, not anonymous export. Source IDs never choose local filenames; archive child paths are opened no-follow under retained roots, regular single-link files and actual file/HTTP byte intake are bounded. SQLite archive row counts are not globally capped by this control. Credential-bearing API requests retain their selected origin; signed file downloads may use another HTTPS origin, carry no account bearer and refuse redirects. Live files use random exclusive scratch names. Non-Unix archive file bytes fail closed; see operator compatibility documentation.
